selected_rule.when: When implementation is complete and the carried classification is task_size=Large or architectural_risk=High, implementation-scoped validation is complete, and the cumulative implementation package is ready for independent source review.

evaluation: Initial new-ticket IR-001 complete; Medium/High confirmed; local validation completed with disclosed repository Vue diagnostics and live acceptance limits. Independent source review is required. Not an implementation Local Fix, direct Low-risk route, or discovered Design Impact. Exactly one recipient selected.
send_status: Dispatch follows persisted/committed artifacts; successful tool response is authoritative, not preclaimed.
